title: Add a 'frontier' alias to the seat model validator (with regression guard)
prompt: In src/utils/model/seatSlots.ts, extend validateSeatModel so the raw spelling 'frontier' resolves exactly like the existing 'fable' alias (the frontier family default; an exact id still wins). Extend scripts/crew/prove-crew-spec-floor.ts with asserts covering: validateSeatModel('frontier', 'claude-opus-5') resolves into the fable family, and validateSeatModel('claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-opus-5') is unchanged. The whole crew suite must stay green.
